item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00020","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C15","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is a concrete and material template: both proclamations enlarge a fort-centered national monument by adding island land needed to protect historic resources, invoke the same section 2 authority, reserve specifically described lands subject to valid existing rights, and use nearly identical warning language. The shared sequence and operative wording go well beyond generic proclamation boilerplate. C15 and C07 also provide plausible monument-enlargement language, but C03 is substantially closer in subject, structure, and legal machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim that, subject to valid existing rights, the following-described lands are hereby added to, and reserved as parts of, the Fort Pulaski National Monument","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim that, subject to valid existing rights, the following-described lands in Florida are hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Fort Matanzas National Monument","explanation":"Near-identical operative clause enlarging a fort national monument through reservation of described lands."},{"child_excerpt":"by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 2 of the act of June 8, 1906, 34 Stat. 225 (16 II. S. C. 431)","parent_excerpt":"under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 2 of the act of June 8, 1906, 34 Stat. 225 (16 U.S.C. 431)","explanation":"The same statutory authority is embedded in the same position within the operative formula."},{"child_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of these lands and not to locate or settle upon any part thereof.","parent_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, deface, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands reserved by this proclamation.","explanation":"Distinctively parallel warning provision following the land description."},{"child_excerpt":"Daymark Island ... is required for the proper care, protection, and management of the objects of historic interest situated within the area","parent_excerpt":"adding such lands and the remaining public lands comprising Rattlesnake Island ... in order to insure permanent protection to the Fort and its historic setting","explanation":"Both predicates justify adding island property to protect a historic fort monument and its setting."}]}
